Agent onboarding: signup URL, auto-created key, free-credit budget and the 402 top-up path. Attribution links refreshed.

Initial release of tiktok-ad-library-api skill.

- Search TikTok ads by keyword and/or industry, with pagination and filters.
- Retrieve top-performing ads, optionally filtered by industry and country, including a performance summary.
- View detailed info for a specific ad, including objective, engagement metrics, countries, landing page, and playable video.
- All endpoints return structured JSON. Each call requires 1 credit and an API key from scavio.dev.
- Includes clear setup instructions, endpoint descriptions, parameters, and failure handling guidance.
